Upon activation, stops attacking for 3 seconds, recalls all "Repeaters" and refreshes their deployment cooldown; Attack interval is significantly reduced, ATK +80% , attacks deal 125% of ATK as Arts damage and Slow targets for 0.2 seconds；If an attack passes through a "Repeater", it deals an additional 20% of ATK as Arts damage and extends the Slow duration by 0.2 seconds Skill grants 2 additional "Repeaters" that can be deployed during the skill's duration; "Repeaters" will not retreat during the skill, and retreat automatically when the skill ends Skill activation grants 20 ammo and the skill ends when all ammo is used (Can manually deactivate skill)
